create_class_S3Path: create an S3Path model with bucket, prefix, and infix string fields for cloud object storage paths
create_class_S3CcsData: create an S3CcsData model with an endpoint and a list of S3Path objects for CCS-parsed file access
create_class_DocumentLicense: create a DocumentLicense model with optional code and text license string lists
create_class_Meta: create a generic Meta model for search database index metadata with validated version and reference fields
validate_Meta_reference: validate the Meta reference field enforces ccs:schemas#/Document for Document type indexes
